name: Sasha
source:
[url=/c105866]Vicky[/url]'s little sister and daddy's girl. Sasha knows how to twist her father ([url=/c105869]Jerry[/url]) around her little finger with those big doe eyes and those sweet freckles.

But behind the adorable exterior lurks a simmering sexual darkness. She discovered her power over others at an early age and she possesses desires no girl should ever explore.

But explore she will, no matter the consequences.

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Sasha]DumbKoala[/url]]
